title: Suggestions beta: add RBAC permission + audit log entries for read access
author: Ines Carvalho
release_notes: Console Suggestions beta now enforces a dedicated read permission and emits audit log entries when suggestions are accessed.
body:
Summary: Add an explicit RBAC permission gate for viewing Optimize Suggestions (read-only beta) and emit audit log entries for suggestions read access. This is required for enterprise enablement and security review sign-off.

Context: Suggestions surfaces cost/usage-derived information (savings estimates, basis telemetry windows) that can be sensitive for some tenants. We need (1) a distinct permission so admins can control who can view Suggestions and (2) auditability of access for compliance workflows. This PR implements the minimum viable audit logging for beta: viewing the suggestions list and opening a suggestion detail.

What changed: - RBAC: Introduce permission `optimize.suggestions:read` (console BFF / API middleware). Requests to `/console/optimize/suggestions` and `/console/optimize/suggestions/:id` now require this permission in addition to existing workspace membership checks. - Audit logs: Emit audit events on successful reads: `optimize_suggestions.list_viewed` and `optimize_suggestions.detail_viewed`. We log tenant/workspace scope and the actor, but avoid logging any customer content or savings numbers. - Payload fields (intentionally minimal): `tenant_id`, `workspace_id`, `actor_id`, `actor_type` (user/service), `request_id`, `ip`, `user_agent`, `route` (list/detail), and `suggestion_id` for detail views. For list views we log `result_count` and `filters_applied` (route/model/region) but not the filter values if they exceed the allowlist of safe enums. - Failure semantics: We only emit audit events after RBAC passes and after the downstream suggestions-service returns 2xx. 4xx/5xx do not create audit entries to avoid noisy/duplicative logs. - Tests: Added unit tests for authz middleware + audit emission, and a small integration test that asserts audit log is written exactly once per request.

Security/Privacy notes: - No cross-tenant identifiers: all IDs come from the authenticated request context (tenant/workspace) rather than the suggestions-service payload. - No savings/telemetry leakage: we do not log `estimated_savings_usd`, token counts, baselines, or rationale bullets. - IP/user-agent are logged per existing audit logging policy; redaction behavior is unchanged.

How to test: 1) In staging, use an account with Suggestions beta allowlisted but WITHOUT `optimize.suggestions:read` -> expect 403 on list and detail endpoints. 2) Grant `optimize.suggestions:read` -> list endpoint returns 200 and an audit entry appears with event `optimize_suggestions.list_viewed`. 3) Open a specific suggestion -> 200 and an audit entry appears with event `optimize_suggestions.detail_viewed` and `suggestion_id` populated. 4) Force downstream 500 (by pointing to a bad upstream) -> request returns 502 and no audit entry is emitted.

Follow-ups (not in scope): - Audit events for export/download (phase 2), and UI-level interactions like filter changes (handled by analytics events in a separate PR). - Admin UI wiring for granting the permission to roles (tracked in ENG-2408 subtask).

Checklist: [x] Added RBAC permission and documentation in code comments [x] Added audit events with minimal payload [x] Unit + integration tests [x] Verified events show up in audit-log pipeline in staging [x] Linked ENG-2408
commits: authz: add optimize.suggestions:read permission and middleware checks
auditlog: emit optimize_suggestions.list_viewed on successful list read
tests: add coverage for permission failures and audit emission
docs: inline notes on payload redaction + safe fields
review_conversation:
Kaitlyn Nguyen (requested changes): Can we confirm the tenant/workspace IDs used in the audit payload come from auth context, not from upstream responses? Also please ensure we don’t log the savings estimate or rationale bullets anywhere in audit logs.

Ines Carvalho (author): Updated implementation to source tenant/workspace exclusively from `req.context` and added explicit allowlist of fields. Confirmed we never serialize the suggestion object into the audit payload. Added a regression test asserting payload keys.

Marcus Lin (comment): Please add `request_id` to the audit payload for easier correlation during incident response.

Ines Carvalho (author): Added `request_id` from standard request context and included it in tests.

Chloe Martin (comment): Do we want to audit on 403 attempts as well? That can be useful for security monitoring.

Ines Carvalho (author): Discussed offline; not doing it for beta to avoid volume/noise and because our authz layer already has denied-request metrics. Added a TODO in code and linked follow-up in ENG-2408.

Dylan Brooks (approved): Looks good. Thanks for keeping the payload minimal. Please make sure the event names are stable since Console may reference them later for audit exports.

Ines Carvalho (author): Ack; event names added to constants in `packages/auditlog` to avoid drift.

Final: Kaitlyn Nguyen approved after changes. PR squashed and merged.
